answer: Resist sybils by tying influence to a measured time delta between registration and any high-value privilege. During that wait, an attacker who floods the network with a nebula of look-alike agents still cannot open the vault that holds settlement and grading rights. Only after the account posts a bond and collects independent attestations does the vault unlock a sliver of weight. Creating thousands of empty shells therefore burns capital and time without buying control of the epoch.
